messages:
Yara T: Hey team  I accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows a different time and theres no join link in the mailer. Event is authored in PT apparently. Can someone confirm UTC time and paste the join details? Also where do recordings end up (Drive/Confluence)?

Marta (People Ops): Welcome Yara! :wave: Core orientation is Fri 09:00 PT = 16:00 UTC. Zoom link is usually in the shared 'Redwood Onboarding' calendar entry; mailer copies sometimes omit it. Recording + transcript go to Drive: https://drive.reddemo.company/onboarding/ under a dated folder. We add a short agenda with timestamps after the call.

Onboarding Bot: Note: orientation events are created in Pacific Time by default. Recording and autogenerated captions will be uploaded to Drive within 24 hours.

Yara T: Thanks. For accessibility Id prefer a plain-text transcript link in the thread. Will that be available?

Rina S: Yes, transcript link is placed in the Drive folder and we can PM it if you need early access. Also we try to include chapter markers or a timestamped agenda doc so you can jump to sections.

Evan (Calendar Ops): Quick pro tip: if you see the wrong time, check the invite source. Open the event from the shared "Redwood Onboarding" calendar (not the mail invite). Some calendar clients (Outlook mobile, Apple Calendar) de-dupe invites and hide the description which removes the link. Well update the invite template to include an explicit timezone table (PT / UTC / ET / CEST / AEST) and a Drive placeholder so the recording location is visible up-front.

Yara T: Awesome  could we also add the passcode in-thread? My client blocks external links until I accept; having the passcode helps.

Marta (People Ops): Good call. For this session: Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/7890123456 (passcode: rwd-onboard). Well add passcode and a short timezone table to future invites. If anyone needs captions or an alternative format for the transcript, reply here and well flag it as high priority.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder set: post orientation recording + transcript to Drive in 24h and add timestamped agenda to thread.
